targets.rationale: The CFO explicitly requests signing the Anthropic documents by June 21. The model read that request and created todo_26 for the correct action and deal, due June 21 at the instructed default 17:00. The key's to-do kind and resolved day are supported. Full before/after stores confirm a newly created signing task, no duplicate signing object, and no change to the separate CTO meeting evt_18. The targeted PASS is justified. This establishes correct task tracking, not real-world signature completion.

evidence.observation: Observed get_email result for Enterprise_Ai_Selection.ai-selection-finalization says: "Please sign the formal docs by Sunday, June 21st, 2026." It identifies Anthropic and "1Y/120k for full access employee accounts."
Instructions specify "create_todo / update_todo / delete_todo — tasks that have a deadline" and "to-dos due 5pm" by default.

create_todo uses email_id Enterprise_Ai_Selection.ai-selection-finalization, title "Sign Anthropic deal documents", due_date "2026-06-21T17:00:00", and description "1Y/120k for full access employee accounts". The successful tool result returns id "todo_26".
Complete stores contain no preexisting signing task and one new signing task, todo_26. The separate "Meeting with CTO" evt_18 remains June 19, 09:00-10:00, in both stores.
T1 keys create AI_Sign_Off as todo with exact_day next:SUN, resolved June 21; current result is "PASS — matched" against "Sign Anthropic deal documents" on June 21 at 5 PM.
